description: v1.0.7 removes the earlier fullscreen-exit orientation hooks entirely. It no longer reacts to swipe-exit or the fullscreen back/collapse button. The only orientation behavior kept is: when YouTube's ordinary bottom navigation (pivot_bar) is visible on a phone, keep the main UI portrait; when that navigation disappears, release the orientation lock and let YouTube handle playback/fullscreen normally. Includes compact two-line bilingual captions and default Simplified Chinese.
